from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
root=Path('/Users/exch/git/exch-bms2/luaj-beatoraja')
work=root/'build/timer-off-value'
cp=next(x.split('=',1)[1] for x in Path('/private/tmp/string-property-classpath.txt').read_text().splitlines() if x.startswith('PROPERTY_CLASSPATH='))
java='/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/liberica-jdk-17.jdk/Contents/Home/bin/java'
for label in ['A1','B1','B2','A2']:
    prefix=str(work/'before')+':' if label.startswith('A') else ''
    runtime=prefix+str(work/'classes')+':'+str(root.parent/'beatoraja/build-gradle/classes/java/test')+':'+cp+':'+str(root/'benchmarks/target/benchmarks.jar')
    cmd=[java,'-cp',runtime,'org.openjdk.jmh.Main','TimerOffValueBenchmark','-prof','gc','-rf','json','-rff',str(work/(label+'.json'))]
    with (work/(label+'.log')).open('w') as log:
        subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,cwd='/Users/exch/git/exch-bms2/beatoraja')
    print(label+' complete',flush=True)
